items.title: Mahomet Cub Scout Pack 25
items.text:
Mahomet, Illinois Cub Scout Pack 25 was formed on November 30, 1947* and is chartered by the Mahomet-Seymour Parent Teacher Organization.

We welcome all youth in grades K-5 and meet regularly for fun, adventure, and learning — building character, citizenship, and confidence in youth.

items.title: General Info
items.text:
• Pack Meeting — Second Monday of every month, 6:30 PM @ Lincoln Trail Elementary
  • Den Meetings - Meet 1 Monday per month, see Calendar for specific dates
  • Popcorn Fundraiser — kicks off in September

items.title: New Families / Questions?
items.text:
Interested in joining (year-round!) or have questions? E-mail: mahometcubmaster@gmail.com
